career_ladder.note: Junior Engineer (JE) is the cornerstone technical supervisor role in Indian Railways across Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Signal & Telecommunication, and Stores departments. JEs supervise track maintenance, bridge engineering, rolling stock workshops, loco sheds, and signaling infrastructure. Progression reaches Gazetted Group 'B' managerial roles (ADEN/AEE/ASTE/AMM) via Departmental Selection Examinations (LDCE/AISM).

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to Junior Engineer (CEN 03/2024) is conducted in four sequential stages: First Stage CBT (CBT-1 screening of general aptitude); Second Stage CBT (CBT-2 evaluating technical engineering discipline and core science); Document Verification (DV); and Medical Examination in prescribed technical medical categories (A-3, B-1, or B-2).

stages.source_label: RRB CEN 03/2024 — Examination Scheme for First Stage CBT

papers.qualifying_threshold: UR: 40%, EWS: 40%, OBC: 30%, SC: 30%, ST: 25% (shortlists 15x vacancies for CBT-2)

papers.paper_name: General Science (Physics & Chemistry up to 10th standard, 30 questions)

stages.source_label: RRB CEN 03/2024 — Examination Scheme for Second Stage CBT (Final Merit)

papers.paper_name: General Awareness (15 questions) & Physics and Chemistry (15 questions)
Basics of Computers and Applications (10 questions) & Basics of Environment and Pollution Control (10 questions)
Technical Abilities (Engineering Discipline: Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, IT, Printing, 100 questions)

stages.source_label: Indian Railway Medical Manual — Technical Standards (A-3, B-1, B-2)

papers.paper_name: Verification of Original Educational Testimonials and Medical Examination as per Post Category

financial_package.note: Junior Engineer is placed in Pay Level 6 (₹35,400 – ₹1,12,400) under the 7th Central Pay Commission. JEs receive technical and departmental allowances in addition to central pay entitlements.
financial_package.pay_source_label: 7th CPC Railway Services (Revised Pay) Rules, Ministry of Railways
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 6 entry basic pay of ₹35,400 with 58% DA (₹20,532), HRA (10% to 30% depending on city classification X/Y/Z), Transport Allowance (₹1,800 to ₹3,600 + DA on TA), minus 10% NPS contribution.
official_perks: All-India Railway Free Duty Pass, Privilege Pass, and Privilege Ticket Orders (PTO) for employee and family
Comprehensive free medical care for self and dependents in Railway Divisional & Zonal Hospitals
Railway residential colony quarters allocation or HRA
Daily Allowance / Travelling Allowance for inspection and field supervision duties
Children Education Allowance (CEA) and Hostel Subsidy
Holiday Home booking facilities at major tourist and pilgrimage destinations across Indian Railways
